This '''Unidentified Czerka Corporation warehouse manager''' managed a [[Unidentified Czerka Corporation warehouse|Czerka warehouse]] and was a friend of [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Yuka Laka]]. The manager got into debt and sold [[HK-47]] from the warehouse to Yuka claiming that "no-one would miss it".
